text.p: Franklin Covey Co said it repurchased 750,000 shares from chairman and chief executive Hyrum Smith.
The company said it has agreed to repurchase the shares at a price equal to the lower of $24 per share or the average closing price during the 20 day period commencing August 1, 1997.
Smith will still own about 950,000 shares or 3.8 percent of the company's common stock.
The company said Smith's sale of shares satisfies a charitable commitment made several years ago.
The repurchase will leave 795,000 shares available under the company's current share repurchase program.
"The company is very interested in accumulating shares at these price levels," Franklin Covey president Jon H. Rowberry said.
"This transaction not only enables Mr. Smith to meet his personal obligations, but also benefits current shareholders with a reduced share count," he said.
